compute_lattice_metrics: compute lattice metrics and save length and angle histogram plots for crystal structures
get_lengths_angles: extract lattice lengths and angles arrays from a list of crystal array dictionaries
plot_lengths_angles_histograms: plot seaborn FacetGrid histograms comparing predicted and ground truth lattice lengths and angles
get_dfs_lengths_angles: create DataFrames for lattice lengths and angles with optional ground truth comparison data
pairplot: generate a seaborn pairplot histogram comparing predicted and ground truth lattice lengths and angles
